caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely about speed and almost always about patience. When the grade kicks up into the cloud forest, the mountain demands a gear you didn't know you had. It is a quiet, singular kind of effort where the only sound is the gravel crunching under tires and the forest breathing around you. You learn quickly that the terrain here doesn't negotiate; you simply find a rhythm, keep your eyes on the next bend, and let the ascent unfold exactly as it must.
